title: Enterprise release-readiness gate and support-claim ledger
goal: Create a single evidence-backed go/no-go release gate that tells the truth about what AegisPT can safely claim, what is validated, and what remains unsupported.
scope: Aggregate existing validation evidence into an enterprise release-readiness report and machine-readable ledger. Include product acceptance, wizard/profile matrix, runner/tool readiness, lab detection proof, false-positive/false-negative posture, evidence integrity, report quality, AI feature availability, security self-test, accessibility, deployment hardening, backup/restore, and known unsupported gaps. The gate must fail closed when evidence is missing instead of allowing unsupported marketing claims.
generation_reason: The backlog already contains many validation and readiness tasks, but enterprise readiness needs a final support-claim ledger that aggregates them and prevents overclaiming. This is the answer to 'does it actually do what it says and are results reliable?' at release time.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Release-readiness aggregation only. Do not fake evidence, lower gates, or mark unsupported capabilities as supported.

success_criteria: A machine-readable support-claim ledger lists every major product claim as supported, supported-with-gap, blocked, or unsupported.
Each supported claim links to validation evidence, task completion, test output, or lab proof.
Missing evidence fails the release-readiness gate with a concrete next task reference.
The human report explains reliability limits, skipped/blocked capabilities, and safe next steps without marketing overclaim.
The gate can be run locally and in CI without live customer targets.
Results are stored under codex/results/ and summarized in CURRENT_STATE.md when promoted.

acceptance_criteria: The release gate refuses to call AegisPT enterprise-ready when required evidence is missing.
Unsupported or partially supported capabilities are visible and mapped to backlog tasks.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the only active task.
after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Changing product claims to make the gate pass
